sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK A. Readback and Hearback

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, hold short of runway tree four, traffic landing.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, after departure climb to flight level tree tree zero, report passing 5,000 feet.
TAMNA

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, descend to flight level two four zero, cross TAMNA at or above one zero thousand.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn left heading tree one zero, cleared for the ILS runway tree four approach.

sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK B. Checking, Clarifying, Confirming, Informing

body.text: Your required landing distance today is 2,900 metres. Runway one six is 2,400 metres long and the surface is wet. Listen to the controller, respond with a reason, and tell him what you need instead.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, are you able to accept runway one six?

Center cleared you to fly heading tree one zero. You had to turn left to heading two niner zero to stay clear of a build-up, and you are still on that heading. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, confirm maintaining heading tree one zero?

During your takeoff roll you saw a maintenance vehicle moving towards the runway from taxiway Juliet. You were too busy to report it then. Departure now calls you. Acknowledge the instruction, and report what you saw.

body.label: Departure
body.text: HL123, Gimpo Departure, radar contact, climb to flight level one five zero.

You have been in continuous light to moderate turbulence for the last 20 minutes. A preceding aircraft has reported smooth air two levels above you. Contact Jeju Control. Make a request with a reason.
SIMUN

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, climb to flight level tree eight zero. If unable, maintain flight level tree four zero until SIMUN.
Cheongju Approach / runway in use / wind check

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK A. Role-play & Follow-up

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123 at Gimpo Airport, ready to taxi for departure to Cheongju. You have information Delta and runway tree four is in use. Your required takeoff distance today is 2,900 metres.

body.text: Gimpo Ground / information Delta
Contact Gimpo Ground and request taxi.
Listen to the ground controller, give a full readback, and acknowledge the delay.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, Gimpo Ground, taxi to runway tree four via Papa and Golf, hold short of Golf tree. There's an A350 unserviceable at the holding point ahead of you, so it may be a while — I'll keep you posted.
runway tree two right / takeoff distance available
Listen to the ground controller and respond accordingly. Tell him what you need to know before you decide.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, I can offer you runway tree two right instead — you'd go via Hotel and be number one. Do what you need to do.
Listen to the ground controller, then state your decision with a reason.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, runway tree two right has tree,200 metres available, and the surface is dry.
Listen to the ground controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, taxi to runway tree two right via Hotel, hold short of Hotel two, contact Gimpo Tower on 118.1.
Listen to the tower and give a full readback.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, Gimpo Tower, behind the departing Cessna Citation, line up and wait runway tree two right.
Listen to the tower and give a full readback.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, cleared for takeoff runway tree two right, climb to 4,000 feet, report passing 2,500 feet.

pre.text: Situation Update You are airborne and passing 2,500 feet, climbing to 4,000 feet.

body.text: Contact Gimpo Departure, report your passing altitude and request further climb.
direct SIMUN
Listen to the controller, give your full readback, then tell him what you need to know before you accept.

body.label: Departure
body.text: HL123, radar contact, climb to flight level two tree zero. I can give you direct SIMUN if you want it — it'll cut the corner off your route. Up to you.
Listen to the controller, state your decision with a reason, and make any request you need.

body.label: Departure
body.text: HL123, direct SIMUN saves you about 40 track miles, but it takes you through an area of moderate turbulence at your level.
Follow up question.

In this situation, Ground offered you a different runway while an aircraft ahead of you was unserviceable. What did you need to know before you accepted it, and why? In your role as a pilot, how do you decide whether a runway change is worth taking? Give an example of a runway change you would turn down.

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK B. Extended Role-play : Single Incident/Emergency Related

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, descending through flight level one eight zero for one one thousand, inbound to Cheongju Airport. You have information Hotel. Your required landing distance is 2,900 metres.

body.text: Contact Cheongju Approach and report your position.
TAMNA ONE arrival / ILS runway tree four
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Cheongju Approach, descend to 9,000 feet, reduce speed to two one zero knots, expect the TAMNA ONE arrival, ILS runway tree four, Cheongju altimeter two niner niner two.

pre.text: Situation Update Passing 12,000 feet you get a CARGO SMOKE warning for the aft hold. You have discharged the fire bottles and the suppressant will last about 60 minutes. The cabin is clear and the passengers are not affected.

body.text: Declare an emergency, inform the controller of your situation, and request priority for landing.
Yangyang / landing distance available
Listen to the controller. Tell him what you need to know before you decide.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger. Cheongju is two five minutes from you. Yangyang is only one two minutes if you want to go there instead. What would you like?
Listen to the controller, then state your decision with a reason.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Yangyang has 2,500 metres available. Cheongju has tree,600.
Listen to the controller, give a full readback and say your intentions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, turn right heading zero tree zero for vectors to the ILS, descend to 5,000 feet. Say your intentions.
Listen to the controller and provide both pieces of information.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, two things — say your fuel endurance and the number of persons on board.

pre.text: Situation Update The smoke warning went out about tree minutes after you discharged the bottles. You have 1 hour 25 minutes of fuel, and 172 passengers and 8 crew on board.

body.text: Listen to the controller, give him an update, answer his question, and say what you will need on arrival.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, the fire service wants to know — do you intend to evacuate on the runway, or will you taxi clear?
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway tree four approach, contact Cheongju Tower on 119.2.

body.text: What happened to your aircraft (HL123)? Explain the nature of the incident.
How do you think the incident was handled by the air traffic controller? Do you feel the situation could have been handled differently? Make a comment from a pilot's point of view.
